Nag-start po kami sa maraming individuals hanggang sa ma-trim down po namin ngayon. Kaya sinabi ko po kahapon sa katanungan ng ating Senate President, ganoon ba katagal pa ito? And I said we have great progress. Dahil nagsimula po kami sa marami, ngayon na-trim down na po namin sa iilang personalidad po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Pangalawa sa huling katanungan ko po, Ginoong Testigo, ay itong threat na ito. Ito po hanggang ngayon ay continuing threat po ito, or puwedeng i-execute anytime ng mga sinasabi ninyong persons of interest?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yun na po yung ating pong pangamba na nakikita. Because hindi po natin nakukuha, sigurado po tayo na may kinausap at pumayang, subalit yung pagkakakilanlan ng taong kinausap ay hindi pa rin po natin nakukuha. So ibig sabihin po, yung threat po na ito sa Pangulo is a continuing and active threat, po in serious. So yun po yung gusto nating i-address dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Panguling katanungan na lamang, Mr. Witness. Na-informa na po ba ang Pangulo at ang kanyang PSG para alam nila ang kanilang gagawin at hindi po sila malingat sa kanilang siguridad?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Meron po kaming tuloy-tuloy na pakikipag-ugnayan sa palasyo po. I will not mention who exactly yung mga kausap po namin doon but there's always continuing threat assessment po na ginagawa po kami.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Witness. Presiding Officer, thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you Sen. Judge Erwin Tulfo, Sen. Judge Lacson. Thereafter, we will recognize first with the indulgence of Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo, the lead prosecutor for her manifestation. As I understand, she asked for time for a huddle to determine whether she will still conduct redirects. So, Senator Judge Lacsonas, recognized. You have two minutes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Thank you, sir, Presiding Officer. Follow-up lang ito sa mga points raised by Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo kahapon relating to three similar cases: Ronel Mas, Mayor Baste Duterte, saka VP Sara. Hindi ko na ibe-belabor 'yung Ronel Mas and Mayor Baste kasi aware naman ako doon sa Rule 113, Section 5, 'yung warrantless arrest, na hindi puwedeng i-apply. Nagkamali nga 'yung NBI kay Ronel Mas, kaya na-dismiss 'yung case, 'di po ba? But I'm more interested in the cases of Mayor Baste at saka kay VP Sara, kasi almost similar 'yung kanilang mga sinabi. Pero I'm just wondering why you did not investigate Mayor Baste, pero si Mayor Sara, hindi lang kayo nag-investigate, nag-prepare pa kayo ng complaint sa DOJ, 'di po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yan po 'yung aming ginawang investigation ay doon na po sa threat na sinasabi namin na pangkalawakan. 'Yung dito po kay Mayor Baste, kaya hindi po natin iniimbestigahan, isinasama po namin dito sa task force na ito to come out with the report eventually. But we have coordination also po with other agencies.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Yes. So walang ongoing law-enforcement investigation against Mayor Baste?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Kasama po dito sa special task force po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: 'Yung bang Special Task Force—and this was also raised by the Presiding Officer nung nasa lounge kami kanina—na-form ba ito in relation to or in reference to the case of Mayor Baste o kay Vice President Sara?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yung pong trigger point na nangyari dito ay 'yung pong kay Mayor Baste po. But prior to that, we were continually monitoring the threat. Kasama po sa aming pag-uusap 'yan. In fact, 'yung pong aming reporting of records, as early as noong nag-assume po ako ng February, mga first week pa lang po ng March, kasama na po sa reporting 'yung mga threat assessment. But nung napansin po namin na itong rage rally na ito can escalate to a bigger threat to national security, doon po namin ipinasok ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: So mas ang ginamit ninyo 'yung kay Mayor Baste as an open source, kaysa sa mag-file kayo ng criminal complaint against Mayor Baste?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ganoon po 'yung naging process namin dito. But eventually, we have an agreement within us that if we can establish that the elements for grave threats will be there, we will be contemplating also filing grave threats and inciting to sedition as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Pero halos pareho, eh. Kaya iniisip ko baka merong double standard. Bakit kaya nag-focus kay Vice President, pero hindi n'yo in-apply kay Mayor Baste? Eh halos pareho ang sinabi nila. Maliwanag naman, bukod doon sa January 2026, naulit pa ng April 12, di ba, na sinabing [unclear], threat against the first family; nasundan pa ng ‘pupugot, ang kailangan lang namin 'yung ulo.’ Pero kay Vice President, halos ganoon din, eh. Pero bakit inimbestigahan n'yo si Vice President Sara at na-refer n'yo na sa DOJ for preliminary investigation, pero 'yung kay Mayor Baste, parang uneven, nasa law-enforcement investigation pa rin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sapagkat ang isa pong dine-develop namin dito na theory po is 'yung sabwatan. And alam po natin, if we go to court using the theory of conspiracy, medyo mas mahirap po na ipasok na kaso. So kaya it's taking much time to develop the case po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: May request for additional time, Mr. Presiding Officer. Punta lang kay Lascañas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Okay. 'Yung kay Lascañas, ginamit ninyo 'yung kanyang affidavit na isinumite sa ICC.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Parang pang open source. Not for anything, di ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Not for anything po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: So walang evidentiary value ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yun po ay ang basehan namin, kaya po namin iprinisinta. Isa po sa naging basehan namin dun po sa isa nga dun sa five standards po natin na pattern of violence po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Pero wala kayong intention na kung magpapile kayo ng kaso, As a

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: As a matter of reference lang po, for the purpose of establishing the pattern of violence. But to directly papanagutin po sa isang krimen or what, eh sa palagay ko po baka po hindi ito tatanggapin ng korte po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Yeah, kasi kung open source, hindi nga tatanggapin ng korte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Kasi kung open source, kung nag-extend pa kayo and expanded 'yung open-source information gathering, dapat sana na-review ninyo rin 'yung aming committee hearing dito. 'Yung na-mention kanina ng defense na initially deny nang deny talaga si Arturo Lascañas tungkol sa DDS, EJK, et cetera. Eventually, nag-retract siya, talagang 180 degrees. Sinabi niya, totoo 'yung EJK. Hindi ba dapat part din 'yon ng open-source information gathering ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. Actually, nung binasa po namin 'yung affidavit, may isang paragraph doon na nagtukoy nga diyan na nag-testify at saka binawi. Ang sinundan na po namin dito—at naalala ko po, meron kasing news report doon sa 24 Oras after ng pre-trial po sa ICC—nagkaroon po ng interview kay Lascañas kung saan sinasabi niya 'yung affidavit na ginawa niya na isinumite sa ICC. At nung kinukumpara po namin doon sa sinasabi niya, lumalabas na 'yun po. Pangatlo na po 'yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: So alam ninyo, iba 'yung affidavit niya, 'yung kanyang testimony sa Public Order and Dangerous Drugs Committee, which, as I said earlier, I chaired. Kaya alam ko, familiar ako. Then after that, nag-retract siya, talagang complete turnaround. So I even consulted a retired justice na kaibigan ko: ano bang mas matimbang dito? Ang sabi niya, talagang jurisprudence, 'yung original na statement ang mananaig kaysa doon sa parang binaligtad na statement, which I also agreed. Ang point ko lang is, bakit parang namili lang kayo ng open source?

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Kung titingnan ninyo 'yung sa ICC na isinumite na pagkahaba-haba, sa akin nga po sinabi kanina, pangatlo na po 'yung magkakaibang affidavits ni Arturo Lascañas. May nauna, may pangalawa. Pangatlo na po itong pinapakita sa screen kahapon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. And we are also aware doon sa pagbalibaligtad. But on the news that I was mentioning po, Your Honor, mismong sinabi niya, pipirmahan 'yung affidavit, at sinabi po niya, ‘This is 186 pages.’ So nung tinitingnan po namin 'yung statement na iyan, tumugma. At pangalawa, it's been the subject already of an ICC. It's being used as evidence. At least there is a legitimate court that's looking into it. It was considered—ibig sabihin, tinanggap po ng isang legitimate na korte po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: I'm not trying to put you on the spot. I'm just trying to be fair. Kasi gusto ko talagang maliwanagan para pagdating ng takdang oras, alam po yung aking boto. Thank you,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Lacson. Before the Chair recognizes Senators, Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo, Senator Judge Aquino, and Senator Judge Padilla, Chair would like to call on the lead prosecutor again.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Thank you for the sequence.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Yes, what is the pleasure of the lead prosecutor? Shall you conduct, redirect?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, the prosecution believes that we have sufficiently established that the threat to the President constitutes threat to the national security.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, you are once again reminded to kindly avoid conclusions of law. The question was simple, so I guess you will not conduct any further redirect.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nonetheless, Your Honor, there are some manifestations that I would like to make.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: As long as these are not conclusions of fact and law, counsel, as

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: you have been

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: reminded and guided accordingly. You may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: It is the position, Your Honor, of the prosecution that we have established already. Objection, Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Honor. Again, this is a conclusion of fact and law, Your Honor. Counsel,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I'm... The council correspondent is correct. I will give the same limitation to whatever manifestations he will make in this regard.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Let me do it for you. I guess you're not conducting any redirect anymore because you're satisfied.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: I have another manifestation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: And you're contended with the testimony given by the witness you presented. What is your second manifestation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nais ko lamang pong liwanagin, Your Honor, kaugnay ng affidavit ni Arturo Lascañas. Ito po ay iprinisinta ng prosecution bilang bahagi ng testimony ng witness. Kagaya na po ng sinabi ng Presiding Officer nang tatlong ulit, pinayagang iprisinta ang affidavit ni Lascañas bilang bahagi ng testimony at bilang bahagi ng naging investigation ng Special Task Force ng National Bureau of Investigation. It was never claimed by the prosecution that this affidavit is notarized. Kailanman po ay hindi sinabi ng prosecution na notarized ang dokumentong ito. Ito po'y iprinisinta bilang bahagi lamang ng testimony ng witness at bilang bahagi din ng investigation ng NBI. To conclude, Your Honor—

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Short rejoinder on that, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The lead prosecutor is not yet finished.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: To conclude, Your Honor, the prosecution finds it unnecessary to conduct redirect examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, counsel. Duly noted. Do you still want a rejoinder, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Just a short rejoinder on the Lascañas issue.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Yes, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, according to the rules, an affidavit must be testified to and identified by the person or the author of that affidavit. And in this case, such was not done. So, an additional manifestation, Your Honor: considering that it is unsigned and unnotarized, the law considers it as a mere scrap of paper. That's just a manifestation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Then, instead of letting this be an ongoing argument between both counsel, let the Chair state—

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, may I just correct the manifestation of—

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: No need, counsel. Let the Chair state for the fourth time: the affidavit of Lascañas was not offered as an authentic document executed by the affiant, only that it was part of the documents used by Director Matibag in his open-source investigation. As also clarified for the fifth time, if I will count it, by Senator-Judge Lacson, it was only part of the investigation of the NBI through what is called an open-source investigation. Again, to reiterate, not as proof of its authenticity and the truth of the contents contained in the affidavit or document purporting to be executed by Lascañas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: And that it is signed, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Let that be the end of it, counsel, if you may, and we can proceed to the interventions and interjections of Senator-Judges. Forgive my inadvertence earlier. The Chair will recognize, in the order that they indicated to the Chair, as pointed out by the Clerk of Court: Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo, Senator-Judge Villanueva, Senator-Judge Pangilinan, Senator-Judge Aquino, and Senator-Judge Padilla as of now. Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo is recognized for his interventions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed sir when you are ready. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Witness, kahapon naitanong ko sa inyo 'yung kaso ni Ronel Mas. Ngayon, tatanungin ko kayo: pamilyar ho ba kayo sa kaso nina Ronald Quiboyen, Maria Catherine Seron, and Joe Mark Ebkay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Narinig ko po sila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Ano po 'yung pagkakarinig mo sa kaso?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sila po ay inaresto ng PNP-CIDG. 'Yung isa po, I think it's in Ozamiz, dahil mayroon siyang sinabi na patayin si dating Pangulong Duterte at nag-offer ng 100 million na reward. 'Yung naman pong Quiboyen, sa Boracay ata, na may offer din, if I'm not mistaken, 150 million po yata na reward.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: So itong tatlo po, sa pagkakaalam n'yo, anong mga trabaho nito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yung isa po, construction worker, hindi ko po maalala yung isang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: 'Yung isa ay unemployed college graduate. So the reason why I ask that: kasi tulad ni Ronell Mas, a teacher, at itong tatlo, mga ordinaryong mamamayan. I-compare natin doon sa ginawa ni VP Sara at saka ni Mayor Baste sa ating Pangulo—pagbabanta—almost the same 'yung nangyari. So kamay na bakal ang pinairal. Kapag mga ordinaryong mahihirap na mamamayan ang pinairalan ninyo diyan sa law enforcement, pero kapag makapangyarihan ang mga tao, you treat them with kid gloves. Why is that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Respectfully po, Your Honor, unang-una, I cannot speak to the behavior of law enforcement at that time. But I agree with you na 'yung pag-aresto po sa kanila is warrantless arrest. That's the reason why na-dismiss po lahat ng kaso na iyon. 'Yung sa ngayon naman po, 'yung mga pangyayaring ito, we go to case build-up and file a case, katulad po nung nangyari kay Vice Presidente. Meron pong nakapending ngayon na kaso, at kung ito po ay mai-file sa court, that is the time that the court will issue a warrant of arrest. So meron po tayong prosesong sinusunod po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Mali nga yung pagka-arresto. Actually, warrantless arrest yung nangyari noon. Pero meron bang nag-utos? Why it was done by the law enforcement people at that time? And what's the difference between the law enforcement back then and the law enforcement people now?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: initingnan po lagi natin dito ay ang ebidensya, ang batasan ng proseso ang

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: dapat pong sundin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. I'll give

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: you an example.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Halimbawa, 'yung nangyari ngayon na pagbabanta sa ating Pangulo. Nangyari noon sa panahon ni Pangulong Duterte at nagbanta si Leni Robredo. Halimbawa lang—of course, Leni Robredo would not do that kasi I know wala sa karakter niya. Nagbanta si Leni Robredo kay Pangulong Duterte at matindi 'yung outburst niya at pagbabanta, at ganoon din ang ginawa ng kanyang anak. What would have happened? Sa tingin n'yo ba possible na may gagawing pag-aresto si PRD tulad ng ginawang pag-aresto doon sa teacher, construction worker, at unemployed college graduate?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Respectfully, it's calling for an opinion but siguro meron po akong pwedeng pagbasihan, base na rin po sa inyong sinasabi na construction worker, teacher ay inaresto dahil sa banta. Eh, posiblipo. May possibility na baka arestoyin po kaagad ang vicepresidente noon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Witness. Thank you, Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo. Senator Judge Villanueva may proceed with his interjection when he's ready. You have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Presiding Officer, Mr. President. Just one or two quick questions to our dear witness. Your Honor, malaking bahagi po, Director Matibag, sa talakayan dito sa Korte at ng buong sambayanan whether or not natukoy na ba [unclear] tinutukoy ng Pangalawang Pangulo doon po sa kanyang video.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: At binanggit n'yo po na may inaasahan po kayong development sa loob ng tatlo hanggang anim na buwan. Maaari po ba ninyong ipaliwanag, Director, sa pangkalahatan lamang po, kung ano po 'yung layunin ng mga natitira pang bahagi sa investigation po ninyo?

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Just to clarify lang po, no: when you testified that the individual's identity will become clearer, does it mean, sir, that the Bureau is now focused on confirming or verifying the identity of a particular individual referred to by the respondent rather than determining whether such person exists in the first place? Kung baga po, 'yung tanong lamang po dito ay sinasagot po ay sino na 'yung kinontrata, rather than kung mayroon nga bang kinontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: vicepresidente na publicly it is an extrajudicial admission. Pagkatapos na

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ito: ‘Mayroon akong kinausap na assassin o mamamatay-tao para patayin ang Presidente at siya ay pumayag.’ So that is an admission na mayroon po. Pangalawa, bakit po natin tinutukoy at hinahanap? Dito na po pumapasok 'yung kailangan natin siyang makuha, hindi upang sabihin na kami talaga ay nag-usap ni Vice Presidente.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Kasi 'yun naman pong sinasabi ko nga, 'yung pag-uusap na may papatay at hindi naman nagawa, wala naman po tayong pinag-uusapang krimen doon. Pero ano po ba ang tinutugon namin sa paghahanap namin sa tao na iyon, sa individual na iyon? 'Yun na po 'yung sinasabi namin that we have to address: the issue of national security, the safety of the President, which is a primary mandate of the National Bureau of Investigation. So kapag ang banta po sa Pangulo ay seryoso tulad po nitong banta na ito, eh ito rin po ay magdudulot ng ligalig, kaguluhan, at disrespect po sa ating law and order. And that is the very purpose of the existence of the National Bureau of Investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yung bilanggit niyo na may mga persons of interest, so yun nga po, tinutumbok na po nito na nandun na po kayo dun sa sino ang kinontrata rather than meron nga bang kinontrata.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Director Matibag. Napanggit niyo po kahapon din yung parte ng network ng respondent na tinatawag na Davao Death Squad. Batay po ito dun sa ebidensyang nakala po ninyo, sabi niyo sa NBI, at meron po kayong nakikitang impormasyon na nagsasabi ang... Gusto kong malaman kung meron po kayong nakikitang impormasyon na nagsasabi na aktibo pa rin po ba ito nung 2024, kaya naging part ito ng inyong assessment sa kapasidad ng respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sa aming investigation, lumalabas na mayroon pa pong mga existing. At katunayan, without naming names, ganito po: ilagay na natin sa konteksto na nagsimula po kami sa maraming pangalan and we've narrowed it down. Siguro ito na ang hinihintay ng marami rin, na finally ma-identify natin. We are narrowing it down already to less than 20 individuals, at may mga pangalan na po kami nito. Sa katunayan po, 'yung iba po rito, kausap na po namin 'yung kanilang mga pamilya o kakilala. So ganoon po 'yung proseso. That's why sinabi ko, baka in three to six months, we can finally identify kung sino 'yung personalidad na 'yun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Let me wind up, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: In relation again to the Davao Death Squad that we were talking about, aktibo pa po ba sila noong 2004? Aktibo pa rin po ba sila sa kasalukuyan sa inyong nagpapatuloy na investigation? Tinatanong po natin ito, Ginong Pangulo, para malaman natin kung yung ginamit po ng National Bureau of Investigation ay base lamang doon sa historical background na binabanggit po kahapon o meron po na nakalap na Ang mga bagong impormasyon ang NBI, nahiwalay na impormasyon tungkol po dito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, again, kanina po tinanong po ng kagalang-galang Senator Erwin Tulfo, we are not limiting it to the Double Dead Squad. Sabi ko nga po, meron pong mga aktibo pa sa serbisyo na men in uniforms at kasama rin po dito ang Vice President Sara Security Group po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So, even those who are actively involved right now, I mean, men in uniform, is that what you're saying?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: That is something that I can say because general naman, it will not go to the identity.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: will be all, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you, Director Madiba. Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Villanueva. Senator Judge Aquino is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Isang tanong lang po kay Director Matibag.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Doon po sa AO11, nakalagay po doon yung mga membro ng task force, no? At yung isang membro po doon ay mula sa Transnational Crime Division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: international nature itong posibleng pagpatay sa presidente? Meron bang... Ang mga

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: mga mga players na hindi po Pilipino sa inyong investigasyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yan po ay isa sa purpose talaga kung bakit namin isinama, para alamin kung sino po. Alam naman po natin, para patayin ang isang Presidente, hindi po isa o dalawang tao lang ang nag-uusap dito. You need 'yung kakayahan mo, 'yung capacity, doon po pumapasok. Kailangan ng pera, kailangan ng network, kailangan ng tao. So tinitingnan po natin ito lahat. Ngayon, 'yung binabanggit po ninyo, kasama po sa ating tinitingnan 'yan. Pero ang isa pong major na rason niyan, 'yung mga pagbibiyahe ng ating Pangulo—we have to also monitor it because the possibility of endangering the life of the President during his time outside of the country—nandoon din po 'yan dahil dito sa threat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay. So kaklaruhin ko lang: 'yung pagkakaroon ng Transnational Crime Division, dahil 'yan sa mga biyahe ng Presidente, hindi dahil merong possible foreign intervention dito sa iniimbestigahan ninyong pagpaplano?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: That is also an angle being considered, but that's not the main reason po. All right. Salamat. Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Aquino. Senator Judge Padilla is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Maraming salamat po aming ginuong Tagkapamahalang Hukom at sa atin pong ginuong Pangulo. Meron po akong katanungan para sa prosecution sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: akin pong mga kaibigan sa prosecution.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Napakahalaga po sa bawat pagdinig ay iyong nagsasabi ng katotohanan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Pagka ang isang witness po ay naging halimbawa ng paiba-iba Ang sinasabi, ano pong tawag dito?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Di ba po kasinungalingan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: This is a hypothetical question, Your Honor. You are not referring to any particular witness?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ah, sila scanners po. Yung inyo pong pinakitang apidabit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor? Alam

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: niyo po, hindi pa po ako tapos, kaibigan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Alam niyo po, napaka lungkot po para sa amin. Atty. Marinig na meron kayong ibinigay na apidabit na nabahiran dito po sa loob ng Senado, dito sa plenaryo ng Senado ay nabahiran ng matinding masasabi nating kasinungalingan sapagkat magkaiba ang kanyang sinabi. October 3, 2016, sinabi niya

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Walang kinalaman ang Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte. February 20,

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: March 6, naiba na ang istorya. Ang tanong ko po, ano ang tawag sa taong paiba-iba ang sinasabi? Di ba po sinungaling?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May I answer, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo, opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Kagaya po ng aking binigyang linaw kanina. At paulit-ulit na rin pong sinabi ng ating presiding officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Pakisagot na lang po kasi yun lang po ang tanong. Tama po ba o mali na tawaging sinungaling ang taong iba-iba ang sinasabi?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: I'm sorry, Your Honor, but I need to qualify my answer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Mr. presiding officer, isang isang simpleng tanong lang po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The lead prosecutor may agree or disagree or state a different characterization. I can state a different characterization if I'm asked by the good senator-judge. You may disagree or agree with the statement of the Honorable Senator Judge Padilla. Feel free to say no or yes, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Ito po ay ipinrisinta sa Impeachment Court bilang bahagi ng testimonya ng witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Hindi pa rin po sinasagot ng lead prosecutor. It's not responsive to the question of Senator-Judge Padilla.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Allow me to, if the good Senator-Judge will allow the Presiding Officer: pwede ba nating sabihin, lead prosecutor, na ang testigong pabago-bago ang kanyang testimonya sa magkakaibang petsa o araw o panahon ay isang testigong hindi maaasahan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Without particular reference to Arturo Lascañas, I agree with you, honorable presiding officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Posible nagsisinungaling siya sa isa, nagsasabi ng totoo sa isa, o nagsisinungaling sa isa, nagsasabi ng totoo sa isa? Hindi na natin malalaman yun. Tama po ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Without particular reference to Arturo Lascañas, I agree with you, Honorable Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Maraming salamat

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, aming ginoong tagapamahalang hukom.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Kasi po, katulad po ng sinabi ng ating Senator-Judge ‘10,000 hours,’ Panfilo Lacson, napakalinaw po ng sinabi niya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: At kami rin po dito, ako po mismo ay gumawa rin ng panukala na dapat iyong mga nagsisinungaling dito, iyong mga paiba-iba ng testimony na nagiging aming mga witness, ay dagdagan dapat ang sentensya ng perjury. Kailangan amendahan ang batas na iyan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ngayon, bilang pakiusap po sa prosecution, sana ay maiwasan natin ang pagbibigay ng witness na may kasong perjury. Hindi na po ito si Lascañas. Ang sinasabi ko po ay iyong dalawang mahal nating witness, si Atty. Jeremy Lotoc at si NBI Agent Calilung, na sa mga oras na ito ay may kasong hinaharap na perjury. Pwede po bang iwasan natin na may mga ganito tayong witness para ang—

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: nasasakdal po kasi dito ay ibinoto ng 32 million na tao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Sana po aming mga mahal na kaibigan sa prosecution ay isipin nating mabuti bago po tayo magbigay ng mga witness na may perjury na kaso o nagkaroon po kami ng dahilan na

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Nagkaroon po kami ng dahilan na gumawa ng amendment na itong perjury ay amendahan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Pwede po ba iyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, with all due respect, I would like to take exception to the question and manifestation of the Honorable Senator-Judge Robin Padilla. First of all, we were able to verify already that there are no cases pending against the prosecution witnesses. In addition, Your Honor, and only to respond to the concern of the Honorable Senator-Judge, ang conviction po ay hindi ground for disqualification unless it is final and unless it is punishable by more than one year and that the crime constitutes moral turpitude.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Alam ninyo po, napakaganda po ng inyong sagot. Sana hindi one-sided ang ating prosecution. Kasi alam ninyo, pag kayo ang pabor sa inyo—alam ninyo, bawal po ang ginagawa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly maintain order within the court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Presiding Officer, bawal po ang ginagawa nitong nasa harap natin, nagko-comment.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly maintain order in the court. The Sergeant-at-Arms, by authority of the Senate President, is directed to kindly maintain order in the court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Hindi po sila allowed mag-ingay. Korte po ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. You may proceed, Senator-Judge Padilla. Who was speaking? Ako po. You may proceed, Senator-Judge Padilla.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: I was interrupted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: With your apologies.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: So, ibig niyo pong sabihin, yung mga senator judges dito ngayon na humaharap sa kaso na hindi po pinapayagan ng ombudsman at hindi pa rin sila guilty, ano pong ibig niyo sabihin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, with all due respect, ang question niyo po kanina ay kaugnay ng pagtistigo,

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: referring

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: to the witnesses of the prosecution, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ang usapan po, are you all guilty or not guilty? Okay? So, tatanong na po ako ng bago. Pwede po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May I be clarified, Your Honor, on your last question about the senator? You said are facing cases?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Alam niyo po, malinaw na po yung sinabi ko and wala po kayong karapatan magtanong ng Sen. Judge. I

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: think Sen. Judge Padilla was making a manifestation and not posing a question to the lead prosecutor in relation to our two colleagues. You may proceed, Sen. Judge Padilla. Maraming

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: salamat po, Gilong Tagapamahalang Hukom. Pwede na po ba tayong mag-advance ng katalungan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Yung pong sinasabi ninyo, bakit niyo po nababanggit ang ICC dito?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ano po ang kinalaman ng ICC dito sa ating pagdinig?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: With all due respect, Honorable Senator-Judge Robin Padilla, kagaya po nang nabanggit ko na, at marahil panglima nang banggit ng Presiding Officer, nabanggit po ang ICC kaugnay ng affidavit ni Lascañas, na ipinrisinta po ng prosecution bilang bahagi lamang ng testimonya ng witness at bilang bahagi ng naging imbestigasyon ng Special Task Force ng NBI. Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge Padilla will please wind up. You can avail of a second round if you wish.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo, opo. Maraming salamat po. Sa ibig pong sabihin, malinaw na kanina sinabi natin na—

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: hindi siya... With the permission of Senator Judge and indulgence of Senator Judge Padilla, what is the pleasure of Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Walang mic kay Senator Padilla. Bakit pag sa kabila pinapayagan sila 5-10 minutes, bakit pag sa amin, sa majority, kinakat agad ni-remind pagdating ng bago, pagdating ng 2 minutes? I think nakakalata na kami. So dapat pag sinabing two minutes, two minutes. Pag sa amin sa majority, pag two minutes, pinipindot ng pinipindot nito. Dalawa, tatlong beses. Totoo yan. Pero pag sa minority, umabot na ng five minutes, ten minutes. At meron akong record dyan. Pinapayagan. Why? Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Comments of Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo are recognized. However, the Chair would like to point out that in the Impeachment Court, there is no majority nor minority. We are all Senator-Judges. And Senator Lacson earlier requested also additional time to finish his point, which the Chair allowed. That's why the Chair reminded Senator-Judge Padilla to wind up because his time already lapsed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga, Mr. Presiding Officer, I'm sorry, I do have a lot of respect in you. Yung sa akin lang, kahit na sino senador, kapag—

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk of Court is instructed to kindly relay to the bell ringer to kindly be consistent in doing the reminder. Polite reminder to the senator judges with respect to the time allotted. Senator Judge

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: I take the comments of Senator Tulfo in order. I respect your opinion. But just to put on record, as you said, Senator Lacson a while ago asked for more time—binigay, walang bell 'yon. Yesterday, dalawang bell sa akin, dalawa o tatlo? Dalawa lang ang bilang ko. And maybe the solution is that after the first, isang bell na lang. Pero kasi from the start of the impeachment trial, we asked the Presiding Officer, at sabi mo nga, liberality, because then if not, if we can't ask questions, baka magkaroon ng motion or mas lalong tatagal. Maybe you've been doing it naman, but 'yun nga, just ask to wrap up. But konti— we all want to get back to work. There's so much that we want to do. At least, wala ngang majority-minority, but at least walang threat ng kaso sa majority. Kami, magsalita dito, parang may sword sa aming nakatutok. So konting pagbibigay din sa amin ng liberality sa pagtatanong. But in accordance with the rules, tama naman po 'yung sinabi ni Senator Tulfo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Presiding Officer shall take in advisement the points raised by Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo as well as the points raised by Senator-Judge Alan. And in that spirit, kindly wind up, Senator-Judge Padilla.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ginoong tagapamahalang hukom, nais lamang pong sagutin ang ating kaibigan na si Senator Raffy Tulfo. Sandali lang po, kaibigan, mas mahaba kasi iyong sagot din nung ating prosecution. Ako po ay nagtatanong lamang ng oo ba o hindi. Pasensya na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly wind up, Sen. Judge Padilla, but you're gonna bail off the second round if there's one.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Tatalon na po ako. Dito na po ako sa aking kaibigan. Maraming salamat po, kaibigan. Sa akin pong kaibigan, kay Atty. Matibag, mahal na saksi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Mabilis lang po ito. Ako po ay napunta sa PDP lamang dahil po sa inyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Kayo po ang kumumbinsi sa akin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Campaign manager n'yo pa po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: At masasabi po natin na isa kayo sa nagpa number one po sa akin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. Sa lugar po namin number one po kayo. Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Atty. Matibag, sumama po ako sa inyo dahil alam ko na isa po kayo sa arkitekto ng pagkapanalo ni President Rodrigo Roa Duterte. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi po, sapagkat noong 2016 ako po ay campaign manager ng Region IV-A ni Secretary Mar Roxas po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ayun. So hindi po kayo connected noong panahon na iyon kay Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo. Kung kayo po ay nagtatrabaho sa mga iba't ibang politiko, kaya po ba ay matatawag na political analyst o political—ano pang tawag po doon—'yung mga nagsasagawa, nagpapatakbo ng politika ng bawat politiko?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, maaari pong matawag na tayo ay tumutulong sa ating pinaniniwalaan na kung sino po ang dapat manungkulan sa ating bayan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo. Ibig pong sabihin, pwede po kayong gumawa ng isang kandidato at manalo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Magkatulog lang po sapagkat ang paniwala ko po hindi naman po isang tao lalo na ako ang magpapanalo ng isang kandidato.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo. So ngayon po masasabi po natin na pwede po kayong magtrabaho bilang isang political operator?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ano po bang konteksto ng political operator? Ang ibig po sabihin... Ako po ay nasasama siya isang political party noon so tumutulong po tayong maipanalo ang isang kandidato ng political party.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ano po ba ang trabaho ng political operator sa Pilipinas? Pwede ding gumawa? Pwede ding sumira?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, ang political operator to be successful kailangan po yung kanyang sasamahan ay magtagumpay ang kanyang pong laban at advokasiya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Okay. 'Yun lang po. Maraming salamat po, kaibigang attorney.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Padilla. The Senate President is recognized for his interjection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Tutuloy ko lang po 'yung mga katanungan ng mga kasamahan natin kanina. Mr. Witness, balikan ko po 'yung persons of interest. Itong persons of interest, ito 'yung nakausap n'yong actual killer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yung persons of interest po can be characterized na merong nakausap.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero 'yung kausap n'yo, ito ba 'yung actual na nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, persons of interest 'yun nga po. Ang sinasabi nga po natin, ito 'yung maaaring makapagturo. Hindi pa po natin nakausap ito lahat. Ang sinasabi ko po kanina, doon sa atin pong mga nakilala, meron na pong mga pamilya na gustong makipag-usap sa atin at magbigay ng impormasyon. Katunayan, nakakausap na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So ito, hindi ito 'yung actual na nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yun po 'yung dumadaan pa po sa proseso ng amin pong pag-iimbestiga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Gusto ko lang, by process of elimination, 'yung nakausap n'yo is hindi pa actual na nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi pa po natin masiguro doon po sa natitirang numero kung ang isa doon ay siya talagang actual na nakontrata o grupo po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: 'Yung iba, nasabi n'yo, may iba rin ba kayong nakakausap pa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. 'Yung iba naman ay makakapagturo kung sino 'yung nakontrata.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Tama po iyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: At itong mga taong makakapagturo, ano po 'yung mga ebidensya na puwede ninyong sabihin na credible itong mga taong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Doon na po pumapasok 'yung mga intelligence report po sa amin, using our tools, the human intel and the officer's intel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Bigyan lang ninyo kami ng concrete example na ito ay credible, puwedeng paniwalaan na magtuturo. Just give us an example.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: So yung ginagamit po namin dito na human intel ay yung mga dati na rin po namin in four months na nasa ground po na nakakakuha po ng mga intelligence na ipinapasa po sa amin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So base to sa human intelligence. Human

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: intel po. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: pwede rin mangyayari na itong purse of interest wala rin kalalabasan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Posible po yun. Nangyayari po yan sa mga kaso po na So

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: yung nasabi niyo kahapong three to six months. Pwede rin after six months, zero. Walang kalalabasan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: h dito po namin ibinabase na mukhang lalabas po ang positibong resulta po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So, in other words, 'yung probability, mataas?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Mataas po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Gano'ng kataas? Bigyan n'yo kami ng more or less lang, in your own opinion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: From the scale of 1 to 10, nandoon po tayo ngayon sa 6 to 7 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Six to seven na merong kalalabasan na magtuturong may nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Babalikan ko lang 'yung statement n'yo na nakakausap n'yo parati, or na-mention n'yo 'yung Vice President Security Group.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Kasama po 'yun sa isinama natin na pag-aaral po, pag-iimbestiga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Correct. Kasama ba sila sa persons of interest, itong Vice President Security Group? Kasi nabanggit n'yo ngayon, kasama kahapon, na madali silang tawagin, nandoon lahat. Kasama ba sila dito sa persons of interest ninyo? Kung puwede ninyong sabihin—I know you're investigating—kung puwede lang sabihin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Actually, meron pong personalidad na kasama doon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Merong kasama doon. But naiintindihan ko na itong VP security group is also members of the government.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yun nga po yung sinasabi ko that there are, actually doon po sa aming nanarod down, there are men in uniform who is in active service.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Puwede rin palitan ng Executive at any given time. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So paano, kung pwede silang palitan, paano nagkakaroon, ba doon sila nagiging persons of interest na merong Potentially, manggaling sa kanila itong pagkakontrata.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 'Yun po 'yung precisely the reason na ayaw po natin na 'yung term na tinatawag na masunog 'yung ating lead na kinukuha. Baka po makaapekto pag nagkaroon po ng mga sudden na galawan. So right now, 'yung tao po nating sinusundan, at para madali rin po sa aming pag-monitor and surveillance, mas maigi po na nakapirmis po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Sige. Maraming salamat, Ginoong Testigo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. Senator-Judge Pangilinan is recognized for his interjections; thereafter, Senator-Judge Go; thereafter, Senator-Judge Hontiveros. Senator-Judge Pangilinan, you have two minutes. You may proceed when you're ready, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Ginoong witness, nabanggit ng ilang testigo bago sa inyo, si Atty. Lotoc, na in so many words, above his pay grade, 'yung usapin ng interagency coordination. At sabi pa niya, maaaring ang director mismo, former director or current director, ang makapagsasabi niyan. Nung sinabi ninyong may national security threat, nakipag-ugnayan ba ang NBI sa iba pang mga ahensya ng pamahalaan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Meron po kaming tuloy-tuloy na ugnayan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: At sino-sino ang mga ahensya o alin dito sa mga ahensya ng pamalan ang nakipag-ugnayan kayo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Actually po, sinasabi nga natin meron po kasing security cluster kung saan po natatalakay yung mga kailangan po pag-usapan. So sa ngayon po, Through the Office of the Executive Secretary, meron po akong mga pakikipag-usap dun po sa military units din po natin. If you will not mind, I will not mention the exact military

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: unit po. So there have been inter-agency coordination to assess and to address itong kinukonsideran ninyong national security threat?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Totoo po yan. Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Dun sa usapin ng Pag iimbesigan ninyo naman, nasabi ninyong may narinig kayong mga banta na panood ninyo, meron ba kayong na-monitor na nagbanta naman ang ating Pangulo bilang pag-retaliate doon sa nasabing banta ni Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ibig sabihin po, banta ng Pangulo sa Vice President?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. Meron ba kayong na-monitor?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kung meron man, hypothetically, tama ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, kailangan pong imbestigahan din kung meron pong ganung bantang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: In other words, would you consider in a hypothetical situation, revenge as justified? If there is a threat to the President, he decides, he likewise publicly threatens whoever, not necessarily the Vice President, whoever.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ito ay hindi tama sa pagkat hindi naman po ito isang justifying or exempting na circumstance pagka nangyari po yung pagbabanta. Lalong lalo na po kung matas na opisyal, hindi po pwedeng maging batayan ang kanyang paghihiganti para magbanta po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So ang paghihiganti, self-defense ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Hindi. In other words, hindi legal ang paghihiganti sa usapin ng kung ikaw ay tinakot o ikaw may banta laban sa'yo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Or when is it allowed? When is self-defense a valid assertion to allow for non-liability for a crime?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Nakabalangkas po 'yan sa Revised Penal Code. Kaya lang, hindi ko po kabisado. Pero kung mayroon po talagang actual na malinaw na nangyayari na, at kailangan mong iligtas ang buhay, karangalan at property po ng ibang tao, at lalong-lalo na ng mga kamag-anak mo o kaibigan, eh doon po pumapasok 'yung self-defense na valid. May mga elemento po siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, just to wrap up: ang banta ng Pangulo, hypothetically, ay hindi tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi po tama. 'Yan po ay magva-violate, kung hindi man po sa batas na umiiral na Kodigo Penal, eh doon po sa Konstitusyon. Bilang isang Pangulo ka, mayroon ka pong katungkulan na igalang ang batas, igalang ang Konstitusyon, at maging parehas po sa ibang tao po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Maraming salamat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Pangilinan. For the information of Senator-Judge Lapid and those who might be interested, the name of the bell ringer is Annika, for easy reference in case there are future reminders or complaints.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Who is next? Senator Judge Goh is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready. And you have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. I just want to put it on record, given that the incident with the sheriff in July 2011 was discussed in detail during the cross-examination of the defense earlier, I just find it proper that I shed light on the matter without any bias, given that these are matters of fact and based on personal knowledge. Since nabanggit po at ipinakita po kahapon—

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Huwag mo nang patakbuhin 'yung oras, hindi pa naman tanong iyon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Kasama na, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Since nabanggit at ipinakita po kahapon ang insidente noong July 2011 involving the Vice President, then-Mayor Sara Duterte, and the sheriff, I would like to examine the relevance and context of this incident in determining the pattern of behavior of the Vice President. May I ask the NBI Director: would you agree that determining the context of actions of individuals is important to have a fair and impartial investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: That is the historical behavior to establish a pattern of violence. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Are you aware of the context and reason why Dan May or Sara Duterte did that? And are you aware of the demolition involving 217 families who were facing eviction?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po ang pagkakaalam ko po si Sheriff Abe ay daladala ang isang legal and valid order of demolition at gusto niyang ipatupad po yung demolition bilang pagganap po sa kanyang tungkulin po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: A simple search online would provide further details. Nagalit po si Denmael Zaranon dahil nakiusap siya sa sheriff na kung pwede bang i-postpone ng ilang oras at i-delay mo ng eviction ng 217 na families. At naalala ko noon na meron pong pulisiya si former Mayor Rodrigo Duterte na ayaw niya pong magpaalis ng mga informal settlers. Pag walang malapitan, walang malipatan po yung mga illegal settlers. Kawawa naman po itong mga to na minadali silang paalisin. Is it correct that Davao City was then, sabi ko nga kanina no, it was correct that Davao City was then dealing With the aftermath of a flash flood, then Mayor Sara Duterte had come from attending to affected residents before proceeding. Alam niyo ba ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, I was informed po kanina nung sinasabi yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Alam niyo bang 31 po yung namatay nung panahon yun? Yun po, nalaman ko po kanina. Actually, nandun po ako nung nangyari po yung insidente.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: At After two days, bumisita rin po si former Vice President Jojo Binay kasama ang ibang

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: July 1, may schedule po 'yung sheriff na paalisin 'yung mga informal settlers na wala pang malilipatan. Ang naaalala ko lang po, nakiusap si then Mayor Sara na kung puwedeng ipagpaliban muna ng ilang oras o araw 'yung pag-demolish po sa mga illegal or informal settlers.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Actually, sa totoo lamang po, since we are here for the search for the truth and justice, I believe it is incumbent upon me to put on record my recollection of what happened. 'Yun po 'yung naaalala ko. Sabi ko nga, may policy po 'yung siyudad noon: if the informal settlers can't be transferred, don't let them leave. Kawawa 'yung ating mga kababayan na hindi marelocate. That's the context. It is important to have a fair assessment of the incident. Magkakaiba naman po 'yung nangyari noong 2011 sa mga pangyayaring iniimbestigahan ninyo po dito. In fact, not just this incident, in our search for the truth, importanteng alamin natin ang dahilan at konteksto ng mga pangyayari upang maging patas, objective, at makatarungan ang ating pagsusuri. 'Yun lamang po. Ubos na 'yung oras ko. Last two minutes na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Officer, salamat po. Tapos na ba 'yung oras ko?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Sabi ni Annika tapos na daw.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Pagtabla yun sa basketball po. Pagtabla sa last two minutes. May

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: extension na five minutes po. Thank you. Second round.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Sen. Judge Goh. Sen. Judge Ontiveros is recognized. You may proceed ma'am when you're ready. You have two minutes as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Mr. Witness, nabanggit po kanina ang political speech. Pag-express ng dissent sa gobyerno, bilang abogado at public servant, kailan po sa tingin ninyo lumalampas sa kritisismo at nagiging national security concern?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ang isa pong kritisismo ay lumalagpas na sa yung kalayamagsalita kung meron na po tayong nalalagpasan at nababailate na batas at lalong-lalo na po kung ito ay maghahantong sa kaguluhan. At makukumpormiso po ang ating national security. If our national security will be under attack, walaki po itong problema.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So kung may kritisismo pero meron din pong potensyal na lumikha ng kaguluhan o gawing insecure ang national security. Dumalampas na po sa kritisismo. Nagiging concern of national security ayon sa tingin po ninyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. Binabantayan na po natin yan ng masusi at mas malapit na pagbabantay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. Salamat po. Ibang paksa naman po, Mr. Witness. Sa lahat po ba ng sitwasyon kung saan nag-iba ang testimonya ng isang witness?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Masasabi po bang wala nang katotohanan yung pahayag nila?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ang testimonya po na paiba-iba ay dyan po pumapasok yung intervention ng Korte na nakikinig kung anong testimonya ang dapat pakinggan at titignan po dyan ano ba ang circumstances, bakit may ganong testimonya, bakit nagbago at eventually kung ano po yung talagang nilagdaan at kinilala ay importante po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Speaking of the circumstances, mayroon po bang mga valid reasons o mayroon po bang mga dahilan kung bakit nag-iiba ang testimonya, sa karanasan at observation ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Marami po. Maaari pong may pagbabanta sa buhay ng tumitistigo o sa kanyang pamilya o sa kanyang katayuan. Maaari din po na dahil may konsiderasyong pinansyal ay puwedeng magbago ang testimonya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Meron pa po siguro na tinitingnan din kung napasasakripisyo ang kanyang pagkatao, hindi naman yung banta sa buhay niya, kundi sa pagkakakulong or kung ano man, or meron pong taong gusto pong pagbigyan sa kanyang pagtistigong.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: So, bagamat siyempre naman po naghihigpit ang Korte sa mga usapin ng katotohanan at standards ng katotohanan, ay hindi po masasabi sa lahat ng pagkakataon na wala nang katotohanan ang isang testimonya, o 'yun na hindi na totoo ang isang testimonya o bahagi ng isang testimonya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tamo po yan, at lalong-lalo na kung may iba pong ebidensya, whether documentary or testimonial evidence din, eh pwede pong isa-ibangga doon sa testimonyang sinabi para ma-attain po at makita kung kailangang tanggapin o paniwalaan ng testimonyang sinasabi po ng isang tao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At doon po pumapasok yung wisdom ng Korte, timbangin ang lahat at subukan pa rin gabaya ng buong proseso na buwiin yung buong kwento at totoong kwento mula sa

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po yun, yung wisdom and of course guided po by the law, the letters and the spirit of the law po. Of course.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Huling tanong na lamang po, Mr. Witness. Sundan ko yung tanong kanina ni Senate President tungkol sa persons of interest. At ang punto po ninyo, tama po ba na pwedeng persons of interest ang kanyang mga security ni Vice President? Wrapping up, Mr. Presiding Officer, ilan po sa pagkakaalam niyo ang security compliment ni Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi ko po ko sigurado sa exactong numero but what I've seen from the news before it's 750 and it's reduced to 300 plus po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: 300 plus ang security complement ni Vice President. Iyon po ba ay kinonsidera ng NBI sa pag-characterize ng mga utterances ni VP bilang lampas sa kritisismo at papunta na or ganap na na concern sa national security? Ibabalik ko po ron sa

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: ginamit namin po na five standards na ginagamit po ng Secret Service ng Amerika in National Threat Assessment, yung pun tinatawag na Protective Intelligence Threat Assessment methodology po. Ibabalik ko po doon, isa po yan sa tinitingnan. Doon po pumapasok yan sa capacity o kapasidad ng tao po na nagsalita ng pagbabanta.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. So 'yung fact na may higit tatlong daang security complement ay iniugnay n'yo doon sa isang standard ng capacity?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: All right. Salamat po, Mr. Witness. Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Hontiveros. If there are no other Senator-Judges, the Chair will have a brief interjection. Senator-Judge Pia Cayetano is recognized for her interjection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, ma'am, when you're ready. You have two minutes. I believe this is a continuation of the lady's interjection yesterday.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thereafter, Senator Judge Alan Cayetano.

turns.text: went on to say nandun ka with all the deputy directors, etc. Do you confirm?

turns.text: Well, akausap ko po si John Consulta.

turns.text: Mahaba po kasi 'yung statement n'yo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: I just need you to confirm: did you say that you were in Sequoia?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.text: And then later on, dinagdag nyo, wala kami sa Senado, we are on stand down because that's the instructions. Did you also say that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.text: Meanwhile, in another interview, you then said, Mayroon request si GM Veloso to help them secure the area kasi napapansin nila na magulo, labas-pasok. turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes, sa GSIS po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Okay, thank you. So, I ask now for the kind indulgence. May papaflash lang ako. It's just a photo, dear colleagues, both parties. Pakiflash lang. So, sabi niyo nasa GSIS. You confirm na nasa GSIS ang ahente mo?

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Pwede magpa-update sa technical what's going on? It's just a photo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Ito. I'm just showing the Senate website for the record. Senate website. Tapos po, nandito po sa right corner. Can you read it, sir? It says contact information. Can you read it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Hindi ko po mabasa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Okay, pa-abot ko sa page. Yung same thing. It is just the Senate website. Page, paki-abot. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Pakibasa lang po yung address ng Senado.

turns.text: Okay na po yung phone number, no need. So, pakiulit, anong building?

turns.text: Opo, kasi nag-iisa lang naman ho ang address namin. Umuupa po kami dito sa GSIS. Iisang building lang ho 'yun. turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: It seems kasi po na you swore an oath to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Thank you very much. So, sa kaalaman po ng ating mga nanonood at masigasig na tagasubaybay ng mga

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Kababayan natin, Rule 133 on the weight and sufficiency of evidence. turns.text: In Section 11 of Rule 132, a witness may be impeached by evidence that his or her general reputation for truth, honesty, or integrity is bad. So nag-ring na yung bell, I will be a... Loyal, I'll follow this na lang. Pero may record pa sana akong papakita. If the body wants, I will show the video.
